Payout of 29 July is short ₹455.48.
The bank credited ₹1,80,774.68 against an expected ₹1,81,230.16. 21 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000036 of ₹455.48, issued 30 July against payment pay_000397. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000036 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000036 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
